{{Top|leg}}
The '''hamarin interface band''' was a primary module which could interface a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] with a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] uplink device. By the time of the [[Black Fleet Crisis]], the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]] had worn his hamarin interface band for thirty-four years, without having ever removed it for maintenance, sleep or vanity.<ref name="Tyrant's Test">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref>
